answer_text:
Here is a comprehensive overview of **Mundra Port**:

---

### 🏗️ Type & Overview
Mundra Port is the **largest commercial and container port in India**, located on the northern shores of the **Gulf of Kutch**, near Mundra, Kutch district, **Gujarat**.

It is a **deep-water, all-weather, berthing-on-arrival port** in the Gulf of Kutch.

It is **India's first private port** and also a **Special Economic Zone (SEZ)**.

---

### 📦 Cargo Handled
The port has been designed to handle **all types of cargo**, viz. containers, dry bulk, break bulk, liquid cargo, and automobiles.

Mundra Port handles a variety of cargo ranging from bulk cargo like coal, grain, fertilizer, minerals, ores, steel, edible oils, chemicals, and petroleum products to container cargo, automobiles, and crude oil.

---

### 🚢 Infrastructure
Mundra Port operates **26 berths** across multiple specialized terminals with a total capacity of **228 MMTPA**, including four container terminals handling **7.5 million TEUs** annually, equipped with deep-water berths up to **19 meters draft**.

The port has a **deep draft** that facilitates large vessels, including fully laden Capesize vessels, to dock alongside its berth.

---

### 📊 Scale & Significance
Mundra Port has a capacity to handle **338 MMT of cargo per annum** — the largest amongst all operational ports in India.

The port handles nearly **33% of India's container traffic**.

It ranks **among the top 30 busiest container ports globally**.

---

### 🏢 Operator & UN/LOCODE
Mundra Port is operated by **Adani Ports** and is the largest private commercial port in India and a key player in the global maritime industry.

- **UN/LOCODE:** **INMUN**
- **Port Type:** Seaport (Deep-water, all-weather)

---

In summary, Mundra is a **deep-water, all-weather, multi-cargo seaport** and the **largest private port in India**, handling containers, bulk, liquid, and automobile cargo.
